# BE-02 PostgreSQL teslim tasarımı

Bu tasarım product acceptance değildir; BE-01 exact SHA CI geçişi sonrası implementation başlayacak. PostgreSQL16, SQLAlchemy2.0.54 sync, Alembic1.20.0, psycopg3.3.6. İlk bağımsız atomik alt teslim schema/migration/connection; ikinci typed version repository ve ilişkili persistence kabulüdür.

Kullanıcı/session kimlik doğrulama lookup tabloları tenant içerik tablolarından ayrıdır. Session opaque hash ve CSRF hash/expiry/revocation saklar. Proje owner FK; research server UUID + original idea immutable. user/project/research composite unique/FK bütün downstream ilişkilerde zorunlu. Tenant tablolarında ENABLE+FORCE RLS ve transaction-local app.user_id kullanılır; API/worker rolü superuser/owner/bypassrls olmaz. Her repository owner+project bağlamı ister; kimlik doğrulama backend tarafından çözülür. App tablo/scheme DDL veya immutable snapshot UPDATE/DELETE yetkisi alamaz.

Brief kimliği+sürümü immutable typed JSONB; exact original idea research kaydına bağlı. Plan kimliği+sürümü immutable, proje seviyesinde monoton plan_version (M1 spec), brief+scope FK, fingerprint tüm onaylı içerikten oluşur. Source/query snapshotları plan version yanında relational FK ile saklanır. Approval ayrıca aynı plan+fingerprint'e bağlı immutable kayıt. Bir research_id bir run lifecycle kimliğidir; retry attempt aynı run'a bağlı, sonlu secondary gap yeni bundle/report sürümü üretir. Başlamış araştırmanın yeni başlangıç planı BE07/04 devirinde eski kimliği overwrite edemez; bağımsız yeni araştırma veya açık revision operation gerekir.

Attempt execution_id/query_id/source_id/attempt+plan version ile; artifact aynı execution/query/source/plan/owner bağını FK'de taşır. Document artifact'e, segment document identity/version ve full hash'e bağlı. Citation artifact/document version/segment/hash/normalizer bağını taşır; exact text doğrulaması BE11'in işidir. Claim explicit version; claim-citation associative table belirli claim_id/claim_version ile immutable citation_id bağlar. RawArtifact/Citation/TextSegment/SourceReport kendi wire sürümü taşımadığından değişen snapshot yeni server UUID alır; aynı ID altında gizli DB-only sürüm yoktur. Bundle version ilişkileri belirli claim sürümü ve immutable citation/source-report kimliğine bağlanır. Report belirli bundle identity/version'a; gap belirli parent bundle/report sürümüne bağlı. Primary gap job dispatch etmez (BE14). JSONB payloadlar wire model dump'tır; DB scope/version kolonları snapshot kimlikleriyle eşleşir.

Run lifecycle, job/outbox/idempotency ve budget/reservation mutable çalışma durumu; source/artifact/document/claim/citation/bundle/report immutable snapshot. FK indeksleri ve owner/proje sıralı read indeksleri vardır. Kısa transactions; sürüm allocation row-lock ile, dış HTTP/AI çağrısı rowlock transaction içinde olmaz. Budget/outbox davranışı BE04/05'te kabul edilir, tablo bulunması çalışır worker anlamına gelmez.

Test yalnız projeye özel private unix-socket PostgreSQL cluster ve yeni disposable DB'de; existing local DB/service/Hetzner değişmez. Admin migration ve ayrı NOBYPASSRLS app-role ile owner isolation/direct SQL foreign-scope negatifler, immutable snapshot/history, concurrent version allocation, engine dispose/reopen persistence, migration upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade çalışır. Migration downgrade destructive işlemi yalnız disposable testDB'de; production rollback backup/compatibility OP04/05'te ayrı zorunlu kabul. Hedef PostgreSQL16/Linux CI ve final restart/backup/restore ayrı gates, not_run finali engeller.

# BE02 evidence schema / typed repository design support

This is read-only design support, not acceptance of unwritten migration 0002 or BE02 parent. Foundation r1 remains independently accepted in its bounded scope. Source hashes accompany these notes. S means (user_id, project_id, research_id); every tenant relationship carries S and ON DELETE RESTRICT. No new wire fields are proposed implicitly.

## Identity and relation matrix

| Stored object | Stable identity / snapshot key | Required relational target and scope | Storage/reconstruction condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Research/run anchor | research_id (server allocated before draft); S unique | Project(user_id,project_id), exact approved plan S+plan_id+plan_version+fingerprint and brief S+brief_id+brief_version | Research original idea immutable; lifecycle/usage/status mutable separately. A retry remains the same research; no new hidden run UUID. Start/idempotency behavior is BE04. |
| Query execution attempt | execution_id; unique S+plan_id+plan_version+query_id+source_id+attempt | query_plans(S,plan_id,plan_version,query_id,source_id), run's selected plan | QueryExecution has no version and carries mutable status. Preserve execution identity/attempt parent; snapshot capture/history separately from mutable progress. Never attach an artifact to a different attempt by query ID alone. |
| RawArtifact | artifact_id, immutable; changed snapshot gets fresh UUID | execution target including S+plan_id+plan_version+query_id+source_id; artifact payload research_plan_version matches column | Explicit plan version and source connector version retained. Fetched successful content has body_ref/hash/nonzero bytes; discovery is not fetched content. File-byte storage/truth is BE08/11. |
| NormalizedDocument | document_id+document_version | S+artifact_id; explicit self-links selected document snapshots | Include full normalized hash and normalizer version in unique referenced tuple. Rejected documents may be stored; do not force an accepted-bundle status prematurely. |
| TextSegment | segment_id immutable, fresh UUID when changed | S+document_id+document_version+normalized_content_hash+normalization_version | Wire segment has document_id but no document_version: take the exact version from its enclosing document at creation. Persist segment ordinal to preserve array order. Unicode code-point offsets differ from UTF-8 byte hashes. |
| Citation | citation_id immutable; validation/status/bindings change => fresh UUID | S+artifact_id; S+document_id+document_version+artifact_id; S+segment_id+document_id+document_version+full_hash+normalizer+segment_text_hash; exact source via artifact | Independent valid FK to document and segment is insufficient: their shared tuple must agree. Exact quote and actual bytes validation remains BE11. Do not create a hidden citation version. |
| Claim | claim_id+claim_version immutable | S+research; citations through explicit claim-version edge; intent IDs anchored to selected plan when known | Claim-version association records must preserve payload citation IDs. Candidate/rejected claim storage allowed; bundle only takes validated claims. |
| Claim-citation edge | S+claim_id+claim_version+citation_id | both exact claim version and immutable citation | Citation.claim_ids has no version; reciprocal validation is evaluated in a specific bundle selection. Same claim ID has exactly one version in a bundle. Do not choose current latest claim during reconstruction. |
| SourceReport | source_report_id immutable; changed counts/status gets fresh UUID | S+exact plan snapshot+source_id; report-query edges to query_plans exact plan/source; report-claim selected versions and report-citation IDs | Every owned citation source equals report source; each report claim intersects its own citation set; directions match claims. Versionless claim IDs are pinned through the containing bundle or explicit repository selection. |
| EvidenceBundle | bundle_id+bundle_version immutable | S+parent bundle snapshot; exact claim-version edges, citation IDs, source-report IDs, gap versions | Capture array ordinals and all nonedge JSON fields. UNIQUE(bundle snapshot, claim_id) enforces one selected version. Bundle version must agree with versions.evidence_bundle when present. |
| Bundle document membership | S+bundle_id+bundle_version+document_id+document_version | selected normalized documents | Needed for duplicate_document_ids, independence.document_ids and relation endpoints, not only cited documents. Capture their exact versions; do not silently look up latest. |
| DocumentRelation | relation_id, scoped to bundle snapshot | bundle exact snapshot + from/to selected document snapshots | Wire from_id/to_id have no type/version. Current active architecture defines document relations; reject unrelated entity IDs and capture exact selected document versions. Candidate/confirmed/rejected relation status is part of the bundle snapshot. |
| IndependenceGroup | group_id, scoped to bundle snapshot | selected bundle claim versions and document versions | Its mutable-looking classification is immutable within a bundle. Do not reuse a globally mutable group to rewrite past independence counts. |
| EvidenceMaps/Coverage | immutable nested bundle data | map claim IDs must be bundle members; coverage rule/registry versions retained | Store ordering and unknown/null/limitations losslessly. CoverageAssessment has no separate entity UUID; keep typed nested JSON or path-indexed immutable associations. |
| DecisionReport | report_id+report_version immutable | S+bundle_id+bundle_version; previous report exact snapshot; report claim/citation membership through that exact bundle | All IDs throughout summary/rationale/pillars/stability/modification/maps must refer to this exact bundle, not merely any same-S evidence. Policy truth is BE13/14; validation literal passed is not proof of real validation. |
| Report gap association | S+report_id+report_version+gap_id+gap_version | exact stored gap snapshot | Wire gap_ids has no versions. Pin the chosen gap status/version at report publication to avoid old reports changing when a gap advances. |
| ResearchGapRequest | gap_id+gap_version immutable | S+parent_bundle_id+parent_bundle_version; optional parent_report_id+parent_report_version; intent/source/query anchors | Every proposed/approved/running/closed/stopped change appends a new version. Mutable current job state is separate. Optional report tuple needs all-or-none CHECK; same-S report must correspond to selected parent bundle as an explicit design invariant. |
| Bundle gap association | S+bundle_id+bundle_version+gap_id+gap_version | exact gap snapshot | Bundle gap IDs are versionless. Persist selection rather than reading latest. Parent cycle handled with row-first, then edges, all in one transaction; do not grant postpublication payload mutation. |
| Internal job/outbox/idempotency | job/outbox/operation keys distinct from research identity | S+research+exact approved plan or gap snapshot; payload identity matched | Record transactional intent with typed parent refs. Dispatch/lease/dedupe/recovery and primary-gap no-dispatch tested under BE04/14; table existence does not satisfy those gates. Worker context comes from persisted trusted job, not queued caller owner fields. |
| Budget/reservation | mutable ledger/reservation identity | S+research plus job/operation | Atomic accounting, unknown costs, cancellation and provider callbacks remain BE05; secondary gaps share run budget, never gain new allowance by using new IDs. |

## Concrete hazards to resolve before migration/repository acceptance

1. **Versionless references must not resolve through latest.** NormalizedDocument.parent_document_id/supersedes_document_id/exact_duplicate_of/near_duplicate_of, EvidenceBundle.parent_bundle_id, DecisionReport.previous_report_id, ResearchRun.bundle_id/report_id and bundle/report gap_ids lack explicit target versions. Require selected version metadata as repository input, persist it in relational edges, and make reads deterministic. The DTO stays unchanged unless a separately reviewed BE01 wire revision is intended. parent/supersedes same logical document must specify a different earlier snapshot where needed; reject self/cyclic history.
2. **Nested segment loses document version outside its parent.** A segment table key on (S,document_id) alone permits a new document version to reuse old segments. Pin document_version/full hash/normalizer, and make citation reference that same exact tuple and artifact/source. Test mixed valid parents that would pass separate independent FKs.
3. **Claim-version ambiguity.** Citation.claim_ids, SourceReport.claim_ids and report claim arrays omit versions. Bundle selects one exact version per logical claim. Associative edges must store that version, preserve both-direction membership, and reconstruct with the chosen bundle, never global latest. Reject report evidence from a different same-owner bundle.
4. **Immutable graph membership needs completeness, not merely valid edges.** JSON arrays and edge tables can disagree while every FK independently passes. Repository validates exact multiset/order membership and atomically inserts payload plus all edges. DB guard should prevent later INSERT of extra edges into a published graph, as well as UPDATE/DELETE. An immutable parent alone does not stop postpublication edge extension.
5. **Logical ID cannot change owner/project/research between versions.** Existing versioned PKs allow different versions under the same UUID to carry different S unless guarded. Establish an immutable identity-to-S anchor or equivalent constraint/trigger for document/claim/bundle/report/gap and typed brief/plan operations; a nonowner cannot re-home a guessed existing logical UUID in a new version. This is future typed repository scope, not retroactive rejection of the bounded foundation.
6. **Optional compound FK half-null escapes.** PostgreSQL default MATCH SIMPLE skips FK validation if any referenced column is NULL. Use all-or-none checks for optional (parent ID, version) pairs; do not apply MATCH FULL directly to a compound tuple containing always-nonnull S plus an intentionally-null target. Use nonnull exact targets for citations/bundle/report.
7. **Gap/report/bundle cycles and status history.** Preallocate IDs and insert owning rows before associations in one transaction, or use narrowly deferred constraints with commit-time completeness. Don't mutate historical published JSON to backfill links. Old report reads must preserve the original selected gap version; new gap progress is a new DTO snapshot. Primary gap may be stored but never causes a web job.
8. **Read validation remains typed.** JSONB object storage preserves strings/nulls but is not full wire validation. Persist model_dump(mode='json') and reconstruct the matching Pydantic class on every repository read; validate DB identity/version columns and all exact relation metadata. Preserve unknown/null fields, aware timestamps, Decimal cost strings, Unicode text, array order, provenance and error/usage data.
9. **Frozen migration / RLS scope expansion.** Add 0002 independently of future ORM metadata, retain 0001 DDL unchanged, apply ENABLE+FORCE RLS/grants/immutability to every new tenant and association table; only lifecycle/budget/job data receives intended mutation grants. Engine's all-public-owner/membership/schema-CREATE checks must still reject unsafe roles when new tables appear.

## Required BE02 parent evidence

- Full nonempty realistic graph DTO roundtrip: plan + attempt + artifact + multi-segment Unicode document + multiple claim versions + reciprocal citations + two source reports + bundle + report + gap versions + relation/independence/map metadata. Deep model_dump(mode='json') equality after commit, engine dispose and fresh engine read. Empty arrays are not adequate.
- Negative direct SQL under application role (and admin where proving structural rather than RLS guard): cross-user/project/research, wrong source/query/attempt/plan version, JSON identity/version/foreign column drift, mixed citation document/segment/hash/normalizer/artifact tuples, incomplete/extra graph edges, wrong report bundle membership, half-null parent pair, wrong gap parent version and identity-to-S reassignment.
- Old/new snapshot reads: explicit document/claim/bundle/report/gap versions, new UUID for changed raw/segment/citation/source-report; all old payloads and associations unchanged. Candidate/rejected storage allowed while validated bundle selection excludes them.
- Atomic rollback: fail during middle of graph/edge insertion, ensure neither dangling rows nor partial publication; transaction context after failure/cancel returns empty or next owner's context with same connection.
- Concurrent independent connections append versions and allocate project-level monotonically unique plan versions without lost writes/history overwrite; exact retry/dedupe/start behavior stays BE04, but repository constraints and locks must be real PostgreSQL tests.
- Disposable database migration 0001->0002, downgrade->0001, re-upgrade->0002, model/migration schema consistency, role/RLS/immutable guard verification. Update existing head-0001 expectations in the same accepted atomic 0002 delivery; never edit frozen old migration to make tests pass.
- Persistence after reopening API/repository process and controlled private PG restart, coordinated to avoid the other verifier's cluster. Linux Python3.13/PostgreSQL16 exact-commit CI acceptance. Production restore/rollback is OP04/05 and remains separate mandatory final evidence.

Remaining design decisions: (a) explicit internal selected-version input for versionless parent references, (b) immutable graph seal/edge completeness policy, (c) global UUID identity-to-scope binding across versions, (d) exact gap parent-report/input-bundle consistency. These require concrete implementation decisions and tests, not user approval.

# 0003 evidence relation design inspection (not implementation acceptance)

Snapshot: evidence_models.py SHA256 0c81d1203644f553bb0f59b73ac88cf630695e3ffa13406c36b91b76ca3b5ec4, unchanged after inspection. 11 typed records,13 association tables,72 foreign keys compile with PostgreSQL dialect; each FK includes complete user/project/research scope, resolves an exact unique parent tuple, and restricts deletion. The own relationship-matrix.json and24 compiled CREATE TABLE artifacts provide the concrete relation matrix.

Citation's artifact+source,document+version+artifact+normalizer/hash,segment+document+version+normalizer/hash/textHash bindings are strong. ResearchGapRequest's optional parent report FK includes that report's exact bundle tuple. Report claim/citation edges reference exact selected bundle membership. Bundle member keys allow one chosen immutable version per logical member, with exact version in selected membership tuples.

Required before migration/repository acceptance:

1. A run independently references an approved plan tuple and a valid brief tuple. Those FKs alone allow a different valid brief from that plan in the same research. Bind plan+brief+fingerprint as one immutable selected tuple (composite FK or a deferred native guard). Mutation of a run must not silently replace the selected plan or user conditions. Query/artifact/claim lineage depends on this stable tuple.
2. SourceReport currently references a SourcePlan but not the selected ResearchRun plan. Its claim edge references a valid claim version but does not bind the claim's plan or require any of that claim's citations to belong to this SourceReport. A native committed graph guard must reject a valid source report from another same-research plan, and require every report claim to intersect report citations with matching source_id. SourceReport supporting/opposing IDs must be subsets and have the actual claimed direction.
3. claim_citations and citation_claim_identities are two independent associations. A citation's claim identity anchor can exist with no selected claim version. The graph guard must compare exact ordered payload arrays to association tuples, enforce two-way links against selected immutable claim versions, forbid omitted/extra/duplicate children and ordinal drift, and defer until the entire atomic graph is inserted. Anchor existence alone is not proof of a complete claim.
4. Bundle membership currently allows any same-scope child. Seal the exact ordered source/claim/citation arrays, selected document versions and optional gap membership; ensure all children come from the selected run plan and retain their immutable versions. No latest-version lookup when reading versionless wire references. Parent/supersedes/duplicate relationships require immutable selected versions and self/cycle guards where the documented relation forbids cycles.
5. report_gaps directly references a valid gap version instead of bundle_gaps membership. Native report validation must establish the intended parent context: report gaps cannot silently refer to an unrelated same-scope parent bundle/report. If report-generated gaps differ from bundle-known gaps, define that explicitly and test both cases. This is a design requirement, not a demonstrated runtime defect in an unwritten migration.
6. NormalizedDocument payload includes segments; current segment FKs bind document version/hash but do not prove exact embedded payload membership, Unicode offsets/substrings or computed hashes. Citation offsets/quote must be checked against that selected immutable normalized text/segment, retaining canonical original/source URL/time lineage. Generic JSONB wire identity checks are insufficient for actual quotation accuracy.
7. Runs/executions are mutable; full wire payload must remain validated and mirror immutable selected keys. Reserve/grant lifecycle state transitions and shared budget accounting atomically. Query attempts/fallback/gaps cannot create a new budget. Unknown usage/cost remains unknown or held until reconciliation, not zero. This draft contains no native budget reservation implementation; that separately authorized worker delivery remains open.
8. Install FORCE RLS on all24 scoped tables, owner policies with fail-closed empty context, insert-only immutable triggers/grants on22 immutable designations, protected anchors, security-invoker graph functions and fixed search_path. Test A/B and same-user foreign project/research, owner-role membership restrictions, nested mixed valid parents, rollback/restart/readback and migration downgrade/refused bad backfill on actual PostgreSQL.

Acceptance boundary: no 0003 migration, native graph functions, typed repository or real database tests were exercised. This note is design support only. Existing accepted preparation/foundation/CI evidence is independent and does not certify this draft.

Payloads preserve canonical wire serialization. Internal selected versions bind
versionless wire references; readers never resolve those references via latest.

from sqlalchemy import Column, Table, Text, Integer, DateTime, CheckConstraint, ForeignKeyConstraint, UniqueConstraint, Index, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID, JSONB
import hashlib
from app.db.models import Base, SCOPE

TABLES = {}
IMMUTABLE = []
IDENTITIES = {}


def fk(target, *keys, local=None, deferred=False, alter=False):
    remote = [*SCOPE, *keys]
    columns=local or remote
    name="fk_"+target+"_"+hashlib.sha256((",".join(columns)+"/"+",".join(remote)).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
    return ForeignKeyConstraint(columns, [f"{target}.{c}" for c in remote], ondelete="RESTRICT",name=name,
                                deferrable=True if deferred else None, initially="DEFERRED" if deferred else None, use_alter=alter)


def col(name, type_=UUID(as_uuid=True), nullable=False):
    return Column(name, type_, nullable=nullable)


def pair(name):
    return [col(name+"_id",nullable=True),col(name+"_version",Integer,nullable=True)]


def paired(name):
    return CheckConstraint(f"({name}_id IS NULL)=({name}_version IS NULL)",name=name+"_pair")


def record(name,kind,identity,version=None,*,columns=(),constraints=(),wire=(),mutable=False):
    identifiers = [identity]+([version] if version else [])
    cs = [Column(c,UUID(as_uuid=True),nullable=False,primary_key=c==identity) for c in SCOPE]
    if identity not in SCOPE:cs.append(Column(identity,UUID(as_uuid=True),primary_key=True))
    if version:cs.append(Column(version,Integer,primary_key=True))
    cs += [col("identity_kind",Text),col("created_at",DateTime(timezone=True)),col("payload",JSONB),*columns]
    expressions = ["payload->>'schema_version'='1.0.0'",*(f"payload->>'{k}'={k}::text" for k in SCOPE),f"payload->>'{identity}'={identity}::text",
                   "(payload->>'created_at')::timestamptz=created_at"]
    if version:expressions += [f"payload->>'{version}'={version}::text",f"{version}>0"]
    for key in wire:expressions.append(f"payload->>'{key}' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM {key}::text")
    cs += [fk("researches"),UniqueConstraint(*SCOPE,*[i for i in identifiers if i not in SCOPE]),
           *([ForeignKeyConstraint([*SCOPE,"identity_kind",identity],[f"snapshot_identities.{x}" for x in [*SCOPE,"kind","logical_id"]],ondelete="RESTRICT")] if identity not in SCOPE else []),
           CheckConstraint(f"identity_kind='{kind}'",name="kind"),
           CheckConstraint("COALESCE("+" AND ".join(f"({e})" for e in expressions)+",false)",name="wire_parity"),*constraints]
    table=Table(name,Base.metadata,*cs)
    TABLES[kind]=table;IDENTITIES[name]=(kind,identity)
    if not mutable:IMMUTABLE.append(name)
    return table

# Native preparation integrity draft review

Read-only draft design/probes, not repository implementation or product acceptance. Actual source snapshot SHA256 is recorded in result.json; the draft was applied directly through Alembic Operations to five fresh disposable private PostgreSQL databases. Repository migration head and every existing database/server were untouched.

The declared native requirements are satisfied by the tested snapshot. Composite (S,kind,logical_id) FK plus global (kind,logical_id) PK rejects the same logical brief identity moving to a different research/project/owner in another version. The trigger's ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING cannot bypass that scoped FK. Anchor rows are immutable and foreign-owner rows remain invisible through RLS. New table does not defeat the accepted application's all-public-table owner/role startup guard.

The plan/child constraint triggers execute at transaction completion under the caller's tenant context. Count parity plus exact payload/ID membership rejects missing source/query rows, legitimate-shaped changed source/query payloads, and late extra INSERTs into already committed immutable graphs. UPDATE/DELETE stay subject to foundation immutability and grants. A complete typed confirmation transaction succeeds; denied writes leave the old plan unchanged. Constraint functions are invoker functions; all referenced relations use public-qualified names.

Backfill rejects old logical-ID scope aliases, extra child rows and created_at drift. Failure rolls back the entire new schema/function creation rather than repairing old payloads. Valid nonempty legacy history survives upgrade, downgrade and re-upgrade in disposable test DBs. Canonical 128-query and 512-query valid commits took 0.145s and 1.443s in this private test environment, below the configured ten-second statement timeout; these timings are not a Hetzner performance promise.

Before repository acceptance root still needs: ORM identity_kind/anchor representation and metadata parity with the frozen draft; actual migration 0001->0002/downgrade/reupgrade tests plus existing head expectations adjusted atomically; all application RLS/privilege/function/integrity checks integrated into the exact commit Linux PostgreSQL CI; migration documentation stating the migrator must see all tenant history for backfill. The draft's native checks are identity/graph/timestamp checks, not a full Pydantic JSON validation engine or human approval/auth/start semantics. Runtime typed repository validation and later evidence/report/gap/worker/start gates remain required. No new wire versions or fields are implied.

No actionable failure found within these draft requirements. Future 0003 must extend native anchors and complete graph membership to every declared downstream identity/version/edge, using the earlier relation matrix; this draft currently binds brief and plan only.
